#  12707 - RESCUE PhD Educational Program Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **12707 - Phase-out Module**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **RESCUE PhD Educational Program**  |  
|  RESCUE PhD-Ausbildungsprogramm   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. habil. Cunningham, Douglas 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 3 semesters  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Doctoral students get familiar with the "state of the art" in areas related to their own research. They alsoShow their active engagement and results.  |  
| Contents:  | Participation in an least 5 tutorial events of the RESCUE tutorial program plus active presentation of results on an evaluation workshop. Typically, a one-day tutorial workshop is counted as an event. Workshops that last several days are counted accordingly.Presentation of results from previous / ongoing research work .  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Tutorial / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Seminar / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Electronic access to teaching materials.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Oral examination, 30 min. **OR**
  * Presentation and interview covering a set of tutorials, 60 min.

The actual form of the examination will be anounced at the beginning of the course.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Structural Doctoral Programme / Dependable Systems / PO 2012 

 |  
| Remarks:  | Module content can be composed according to available tutorials.  |  
| Module Components:  | Block tutorials offered within RESCUE PhD Educational Program  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 18.01.2022 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
